```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
jobs:
  copilot-setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Setup CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
        with:
          languages: javascript
          build-mode: autobuild

      - name: Perform CodeQL Analysis
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3

      - name: Load Secrets
        uses: 1password/load-secrets-action@v3
        with:
          export-env: true

      - name: Login to DockerHub
        uses: grafana/shared-workflows/actions/dockerhub-login@dockerhub-login/v1.0.2

      - name: Exchange Token for GitHub App Token
        uses: DataDog/dd-octo-sts-action@acaa02eee7e3bb0839e4272dacb37b8f3b58ba80
        with:
          domain: github.com
          audience: ${{ github.repository }}
          scope: repo
          policy: ${{ github.repository }}

      - name: First Interaction
        uses: actions/first-interaction@v3
        with:
          issue_message: |
            Thanks for opening this issue! We'll look into it as soon as possible.
          pr_message: |
            Thanks for your contribution! We'll review your pull request shortly.
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
